O1.who: Nak runs up as you leave the house (morning, Day 2)
O1.section: Opening: the Sprites start the quest (Spring 1, Day 2)

O2.section: Opening: the Sprites start the quest (Spring 1, Day 2)
O2.line:
There's an old Spring
in this valley.

A Harvest Goddess
lived there long ago.
Now the water sleeps.

O3.section: Opening: the Sprites start the quest (Spring 1, Day 2)
O3.line:
We think she'd wake
up if the valley gave
her wonderful things.

Things that grow,
things that bloom...
all sorts of things!

O4.section: Opening: the Sprites start the quest (Spring 1, Day 2)
O4.line:
You're a farmer!
You've got LOTS of
wonderful things!

Try tossing some in.
We'll be watching!

P1.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P1.line:
The Spring's still
fast asleep.

Go on, toss something
nice in!

P2.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P2.line:
The water shimmered!
I think it wants...
<n> more things?

Something like that!

P3.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P3.line:
Over halfway! Maybe
<n> more wonderful
things to go.

P4.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P4.line:
Just one more!
I can feel it in
my hat!

P5.who: Some crops still missing (said instead of P2/P3 sometimes)
P5.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P5.line:
Hmm... something from
your fields is still
missing, I bet.

P6.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P6.line:
The Spring's banks
were once full of
flowers. Rare ones!

P7.who: Milk, egg or wool still missing
P7.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P7.line:
The old herders
brought gifts from
their animals too.

That's what Grandpa
Nic says, anyway.

P8.section: Harvest Sprites: progress (talk to a Sprite, year 1)
P8.line:
The water's glowing,
but she won't come.

Maybe someone from
the old days has to
come home first...

V1.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V1.line:
When I was a girl, a
fortune-teller said
to throw gifts into

the Spring. Nothing
happened. Maybe I
didn't give enough...

V2.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V2.line:
Vesta says the old
folks shared a bit of
every crop with

the Spring. Isn't
that sweet?

V3.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V3.line:
My granny tossed her
first tomato into the
Spring every year.

She'd tell me
the water shimmered
when she did.

V4.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V4.line:
It's said that our
berries and melons
are loved by the

Spirit of the valley.
Nonsense, if you ask
me.

V5.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V5.line:
These pictures depict
beings offering roots
to a deity who lived

in a pool of water.
Fascinating!

V6.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V6.line:
Sometimes on my
break I go over to
the Spring.

Some gross guy there
gave me a
Goddess Drop.

I just chucked it in
and ran!

V7.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V7.line:
I'm writing a song
about a lady.

She loved three
flowers... a misty
moon, a trick of blue

and one for love.
Groovy, right?

V8.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V8.line:
The old herders here
poured a cup of milk
into the Spring.

I guess they believed
it would make their
cows healthy.

Silly, if you ask me.

V9.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V9.line:
I'd love to eat a
hot spring egg!

There's a spring in
the town but it's so
cold. Even in summer.

If you threw one in,
It'd never cook.

V10.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V10.line:
Some towns leave wool
by the Spring, so the
Harvest Sprites

can weave.

I've seen stranger
things.

V11.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V11.line:
My readings show
something old in the
other pond.

Very old. Bones,
perhaps. Hmhmhm...

V12.section: Villager hints (year 1, while that offering is still missing)
V12.line:
I saw tiny people
with hats by the
Spring!

They were talking
about a goddess!
